contracts.name: Zarr v2 numeric array
contracts.scope: Explicit local array directory or .zarray; rank 1–8; signed/unsigned 8/16/32/64-bit and Float32/64; C/F chunks; endian normalization; full edge chunks; explicit fill; none/zlib/gzip compression.
contracts.range: RasterPixels: last axis X, penultimate Y, earlier axes flattened as BSQ bands; little-endian samples.
contracts.evidence: 29 GDAL entry-point matches; repeated directory/.zarray openings are not independent datasets.
contracts.limits: Groups, v3, filters, other compressors, compound types and undefined missing-chunk fills remain unsupported. No CF axis/georeferencing inference.

contracts.name: HDF5 numeric dataset
contracts.scope: Explicit dataset path or unique rank≥2 dataset; integer and floating arrays; HDF5 storage may also contain NetCDF4.
contracts.range: RasterPixels in storage axis order; no scale/offset or fill-to-mask conversion.
contracts.evidence: 12 GDAL HDF5Image matches plus four pinned offline GDAL vectors.
contracts.limits: HDF-EOS multidimensional axis mapping unsupported. Four library/extent rejections retained. NetCDF4 conventions and arbitrary HDF links/filters are not certified. jHDF metadata requires worker-level resource isolation.

contracts.name: NetCDF classic variable
contracts.scope: CDF-1/CDF-2 named fixed-size numeric variable; separate NetCdfDatasetDecoder supports explicit regular 2D CF coordinates, north-up rows, unsigned hints and retained WKT.
contracts.range: Raw decoding retains storage order and NC_BYTE Int8; the explicit CF dataset API returns canonical north-up samples, transform, WKT and nodata mask.
contracts.evidence: CDF-1/CDF-2 storage-value tests plus upstream byte.nc CF semantics compared with fresh GDAL.
contracts.limits: NetCdfDatasetDecoder additionally matches one explicitly selected CF variable against GDAL, including axes, unsigned values, geotransform, WKT and mask. Record variables, CDF-5, curvilinear axes, unsupported units, partial valid ranges and calibrated/packed values remain unsupported.

contracts.name: GeoPackage feature table
contracts.implementation: SQLite JDBC 3.53.4.0 plus native geometry decoder
contracts.scope: Explicit registered feature table, one geometry column, read-only SQL and bounded row/value collection.
contracts.range: Column names/types, primitive values and GeoPackageGeometry carrying SRS identifier, envelope and GeometryValue.
contracts.evidence: GDAL 2d_envelope.gpkg: both XYZ lines compared with independently recorded SQLite/Shapely values; file unchanged.
contracts.limits: Fresh GDAL geometry comparison covers both XYZ lines. Raster tiles, extension compliance, CRS transformation and spatial indexing are not certified. SQLite native allocations require OS isolation; a Windows Job Object workload is now verified.

contracts.name: WKB / GeoPackage geometry
contracts.scope: ISO WKB types 1–7; XY/XYZ/XYM/XYZM; byte order, nesting/coordinate budgets, ring closure, empty flags and envelope containment.
contracts.range: GeometryValue preserves coordinate order and dimensions; GeoPackage SRS ID is retained without CRS equivalence inference.
contracts.evidence: Every coordinate in seven GDAL Parquet geometry families compared with Shapely, plus malformed/empty/envelope tests.
contracts.limits: Curves, EWKB extensions, mixed-dimensional collections and full geometric topology validation are not supported.

contracts.name: LAS point records
contracts.scope: LAS 1.2 uncompressed point formats 0–3; bounded VLR extents, exact raw integers, scale/offset, return/classification flags, GPS and RGB.
contracts.range: LasPoints retains raw and scaled XYZ, intensity and point attributes; CRS is not inferred.
contracts.evidence: All coordinates of a deterministic laspy fixture, including signed int32 extrema; record/truncation tests.
contracts.limits: No LAS samples were found in the pinned GDAL corpus; this is companion evidence. LAZ, waveform, extra bytes, LAS 1.3+ and VLR CRS semantics remain unsupported.

contracts.name: Parquet primitive table
contracts.scope: One explicit local file; primitive numeric/text/binary/boolean/null values; row and collected-byte limits; automatic extensions and GeoParquet conversion disabled.
contracts.range: DecodedTable retains source column order/types and values. WKB binary may be passed explicitly to GeometryDecoder.
contracts.evidence: All seven all_geoms.parquet binary values match PyArrow; decoded coordinates independently match Shapely.
contracts.limits: No new GDAL differential pass. Nested/temporal/extension columns, Arrow IPC/Feather and GeoParquet CRS metadata are not certified. DuckDB native memory is not bounded by JVM heap; the Windows OS-limited workload is tested.

contracts.name: Georeferencing and nodata semantics
contracts.scope: Explicit GeoTIFF-style tiepoint/scale or affine matrix; PixelIsPoint half-cell correction; per-band nodata mask; scoped first-image embedded TIFF/CF extraction.
contracts.range: Pixel-corner affine coordinates; mask bytes 0 invalid / 255 valid; exact integer comparisons through UInt64 and NaN-aware floating comparison.
contracts.evidence: Fresh GDAL tests verify embedded transforms, pixel-center correction, CRS, all pixels and every nodata-mask byte; numeric unit tests cover UInt64, NaN and signed zero.
contracts.limits: TiffDatasetDecoder and NetCdfDatasetDecoder now extract scoped embedded metadata; four TIFFs and one CF variable match GDAL. Internal/external masks, alpha, overviews, custom CRS equivalence and source precedence remain open.

datatype_difference.reason: The fixture declares SampleFormat=2 and BitsPerSample=24. Pinned GDAL GTiffOddBitsBand explicitly maps signed 17-31-bit integer widths to UInt32; its constructor contains a FIXME naming int24.tif. Hexplain preserves the signed Int32 interpretation. Existing fixture pixel bits match; separate negative-boundary tests exercise sign extension. This is an explained datatype difference, not an interoperability pass.

Five raster datasets (including a selected CF variable) and two XYZ features match. These are separate evidence sets; Docker remains unavailable.
